about: Standard Nepali SME trading chart of accounts using Tally-style Sundry Debtors/Creditors, VAT (13%), and TDS tax accounts.
source: Invented, reflecting typical Nepali SME accounting ledgers.

roles.why: VAT payable at 13% is a tax account in Nepali practice; this product has a tax role only in the P&L, not on the balance sheet.
TDS payable is tax withheld on behalf of the authority, not an ordinary trade creditor.
